pages.label: A little reminder
pages.question: My love, will you let me keep taking you on dates?
pages.description: Even after all this time, you're still my favorite person to laugh with, dream with, and come home to.

pages.label: My favorite yes
pages.question: Will you keep building our beautiful life together?
pages.description: I would choose every ordinary day, every big adventure, and every new beginning with you.

pages.label: One last thing
pages.question: Will you let me love you for all the days to come?
pages.description: You're my best friend, my safe place, and the love of my life. My answer will always be yes.

finale.label: My forever love
finale.title: I still can't believe I get to call you my wife.
finale.description: Thank you for filling my life with laughter, warmth, and a love I will never take for granted. I love you more with every year.
